company: Chifeng Jilong Gold Mining Co., Ltd.
headquarters: A7 Xiaojing, Wanfeng Road, Fengtai District, Beijing, PRC
notes: FY2025: mining segment produced 14.51 tonnes of mined gold (14,510.58 kg = 466,532 oz, -4.27% YoY) and 6.8 kt of copper cathodes (6,754.57 t produced, +9.07%); mined gold sold 14,448.52 kg. Operating income RMB12,638.5M; net profit attributable to parent RMB3,082.4M (+~75% YoY). 2026 guidance: 14.7 t gold, 11,000 t electrolytic copper. Dual-listed: A shares SSE 600988, H shares HKEX 6693 (H-share IPO March 2025). Chairman Wang Jianhua; controlling shareholder Ms. Li Jinyang. Guangyuan Technology (Hefei, 55%) is a resource-recycling company, not a mine (excluded). Zijin Gold announced March 2026 it would take ~26% effective control of Chifeng for RMB18.26B (post-year-end, noted only). Reserves/resources per SRK JORC review, effective 31 Dec 2025, stated at 100% of controlled enterprises (not equity-adjusted); resources include reserves. Per-mine production not disclosed (null above); unit costs given per region (domestic RMB/g, LXML/GSWL USD/oz). report_url is a third-party mirror of the H-share English annual report (same document as HKEX filing).

mines.mine_notes: Operated by Jilong Mining (direct wholly-owned subsidiary), Chifeng, Inner Mongolia. New 60,000 tpa underground mining project obtained mining license July 2025; smelter renovation underway. P&P reserve grade 7.65 g/t; total resources 2.06 Mt at 10.46 g/t (21.6 t). Domestic mines aggregate unit cost 2025: operating RMB180.48/g, AISC RMB277.83/g. Per-mine production not disclosed.

Operated by Liaoning Wulong Gold Mining (100% indirect), Dandong, Liaoning. New tailings facility started Oct 2025 (completion Q4 2026). Domestic mines aggregate: operating RMB180.48/g, AISC RMB277.83/g. Per-mine production not disclosed.

Operated by Chifeng Huatai Mining (100% indirect), Chifeng, Inner Mongolia. Additional 30,000 tpa underground expansion progressing; development ore from technical transformation excluded from unit cost calc. Domestic mines aggregate: operating RMB180.48/g, AISC RMB277.83/g. Per-mine production not disclosed.

Operated by Eryuan Jintai Mining Development (45.9% indirect via Xinhenghe Mining), Dali, Yunnan. Phase II construction transitioned from exploration to mining; heap leach yard under construction. Domestic mines aggregate: operating RMB180.48/g, AISC RMB277.83/g. Per-mine production not disclosed.

Operated by Jilin Hanfeng Mining Technology (100% direct), Yanbian, Jilin. Polymetallic: Zn reserve 75.74 Kt at 2.46% (resource 540 Kt at 2.78%); Cu resource 14 Kt at 0.07%; Pb resource 24 Kt at 0.12%. Beneficiation plant expansion and tailings facility expansion underway.
Operated by Hanfeng Mining (100% direct), Yanbian, Jilin. Molybdenum resource 79.25 Kt at 0.12% in 65.37 Mt; no reserve declared. 33 years remaining explorable resource life.

Operated by Golden Star Wassa Ltd (GSWL), 90% owned by Golden Star Resources (GSR); Chifeng holds 62% of GSR => 55.8% effective. Multi-deposit OP+UG on the Ashanti Gold Belt; largest gold mining rights area in Ghana. 2025 unit cost: operating US$1,860.17/oz, AISC US$1,972.98/oz (up 51% YoY on higher taxes, new mining units, lower grade, early rains). Gold stream: 10.5% of GSR production to RGLD Gold AG at 20% of spot until 240,000 oz delivered (206,659.41 oz delivered by 31 Dec 2025), then 5.5% at 30% of spot. Per-mine production not disclosed.

Operated by Lane Xang Minerals Ltd (LXML), 90% indirect via CHIJIN Laos Holdings (Lao govt 10%), Savannakhet Province. Largest non-ferrous metal mine in Laos; OP+UG with gold and copper processing. 2025 unit cost: operating US$1,472.32/oz, AISC US$1,596.22/oz. Cu reserve 90.09 Kt at 1.69% (resource 244 Kt at 1.34%); Au resource 58 t at 3.84 g/t. SND porphyry Au-Cu exploration project: maiden JORC resource 131.50 Mt at 0.81 g/t Au equiv (106.90 t Au equiv). Khanong copper stripping started mid-2025; new 1.2 Mtpa grinding mill commissioned. Per-mine production not disclosed.

Kham District, Xiangkhouang Province, Laos. JV between Chifeng Gold and Xiamen Tungsten (Chixia Mining, 45.9% indirect). Trial mining license issued Dec 2025; exploration/development stage. Rare earth resource 124.69 Mt at 238.04 g/t (29.68 Kt oxides). 7 years remaining explorable resource life.
